title.value: DirectGPT: A Direct Manipulation Interface to Interact with Large Language Models
title.justification: The paper investigates the implementation and advantages of DirectGPT, a direct manipulation interface designed to interact with large language models by transforming direct manipulation actions into engineered prompts.
title.quote: DirectGPT: A Direct Manipulation Interface to Interact with Large Language Models

analysis.description: The paper introduces DirectGPT, a user interface that enhances interaction with large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT by enabling direct manipulation actions. This interface aims to improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and increase user control when generating and editing content using LLMs. DirectGPT was tested in user studies for text, code, and vector image editing, showing significant improvements in user performance and satisfaction over traditional prompt-only interfaces.

type.justification: The paper is based on user studies and experimental comparisons between DirectGPT and traditional ChatGPT interfaces, focusing on practical outcomes.
type.quote: A study shows participants were 50% faster and relied on 50% fewer and 72% shorter prompts to edit text, code, and vector images compared to baseline ChatGPT.

name.justification: The research focuses on improving interactions between users and large language models through direct manipulation interfaces.
name.quote: Our work contributes a validated approach to integrate LLMs into traditional software using direct manipulation.

name.justification: The paper involves using and interacting with large language models, which are a central focus of NLP.
name.quote: We characterize and demonstrate how the principles of direct manipulation can improve interaction with large language models.

name.justification: The paper explores strategies for engineering prompts in interaction with language models, which is a key aspect of prompt engineering.
name.quote: This idea is exemplified in DirectGPT, a user interface layer on top of ChatGPT that works by transforming direct manipulation actions to engineered prompts.

name.justification: The paper discusses the design of the DirectGPT interface to enhance user interactions with AI models.
name.quote: DirectGPT: A Direct Manipulation Interface to Interact with Large Language Models.

name.justification: The paper uses ChatGPT as the LLM for implementing and testing the DirectGPT interface.
name.quote: DirectGPT: A Direct Manipulation Interface to Interact with Large Language Models.

is_contributed.justification: While DirectGPT enhances the use of ChatGPT, the model itself is not a new contribution of the paper.

is_executed.justification: The model is executed in the context of DirectGPT to test its efficiency in different tasks.
is_executed.quote: DirectGPT works by first entering a prompt to generate an object of interest. Then, the object of interest is continuously represented and elements composing it can be manipulated.

is_compared.justification: ChatGPT is used as a baseline for comparison against DirectGPT, showing improvements in user interaction metrics.
